title: Characters
description: Keep a person's or figure's reference images and look, and bind them when creating to keep them consistent.
useHint: Opens the creation mode you used last with "{{name}}" bound; your draft is kept.

empty.title: No characters yet
empty.body: Upload 1–{{max}} reference images of a person to create your first character.

form.name: Name
form.descriptionPlaceholder: Age, hair, clothes, manner; added to the prompt.
form.descriptionHelp: The description is added to the prompt with the character and is not translated.
form.refsHelp: 1–{{max}} images; a clear front view works best.
form.seedPlaceholder: Leave empty to pick a fixed seed automatically
form.seedHelp: The character uses the same seed every time, which helps keep it consistent. Applies to MiniMax generation only; GPT Image does not use seeds.
form.seedInvalid: The seed must be a whole number from 0 to 2147483647

deleteDialog.title: Delete "{{name}}"?
deleteDialog.body: Work already generated is not affected; you can no longer bind this character, and its reference images stay in the library.
